Public API exports for cross-branch consumption (get_drive_service, authenticate_google, validate_google, reauth_google). Tested in test_google_client.py. Backup migration pending.
make_call() is a CLI orchestrator — parses args then delegates to client.get_response(). All business logic lives in handlers/openrouter/client.py.

fetch_contracts() and call_contract() are test API hooks called from tests/test_integrations.py. The unused_function checker excludes test dirs from its search corpus, so these appear unused despite being actively called. Encapsulation standard requires tests to go through modules, not import handlers directly — these functions serve that purpose.

STANDING LINE, ruling pending — not a disagreement with the standard. The agent-settings lane writes .claude/settings.local.json, which the checker attributes to @aipass. There is NO owner door for that file: @aipass exposes no settings verb, and the fleet carries five in-tree writers of it. The hooks half of this same lane WAS cured on 2026-08-18 (FPLAN-0438 R1) — it now writes through 'drone @hooks hooksound' and reads through the owner's is_muted(), with the /tmp flag-file protocol deleted and zero grep hits. This half cannot follow until a door exists or Patrick rules who owns the file. Recorded as a bypass so the CI gate reflects the standing status rather than a silent red; RETIRE THIS ENTRY the day the door lands. No lines pin: line 163 moves whenever the file grows, and a stale line number reads as a passing check.
